00046 DiskOutUGenInternal::DiskOutUGenInternal(AudioFileID audioFile, AudioStreamBasicDescription const& format, UGen const& input) throw()
00047 : ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(NumInputs, input.getNumChannels() - 1),
00048  audioFile_(audioFile),
00049  numChannels(input.getNumChannels()),
00050  currentPacket(0),
00051  allocatedBlockSize(0),
00052  allocatedBlockSizeInBytes(0),
00053  audioData(0),
00054  bytesPerFrame(format.mBytesPerFrame)
00055 {
00056  inputs[Input] = input;
00057  
00058  if(audioFile_)
00059  {
00060   allocatedBlockSize = UGen::getEstimatedBlockSize();
00061   allocatedBlockSizeInBytes = allocatedBlockSize * bytesPerFrame;
00062   audioData = malloc(allocatedBlockSizeInBytes + 4); // pad a little for 24 bit
00063  } 
00064 }
00065 
00066 DiskOutUGenInternal::~DiskOutUGenInternal() throw()
00067 { 
00068  if(audioFile_)
00069   AudioFileClose(audioFile_);
00070  
00071  free(audioData);
00072 }
00073 
00074 void DiskOutUGenInternal::checkBufferSize(const int requiredBufferSize) throw()
00075 {
00076  if(audioData && requiredBufferSize > allocatedBlockSize)
00077  {
00078   allocatedBlockSize = requiredBufferSize;
00079   allocatedBlockSizeInBytes = allocatedBlockSize * bytesPerFrame;
00080   audioData = realloc(audioData, allocatedBlockSizeInBytes + 4); // pad a litte for 24 bit
00081   if(!audioData)
00082   {
00083    AudioFileClose(audioFile_);
00084    audioFile_ = 0;
00085   }
00086  }
00087 }
00088 
00089 void DiskOutUGenInternal::writeBuffer(const int bufferSize) throw()
00090 {
00091  UInt32 ioNumPackets = bufferSize;
00092  OSStatus status = AudioFileWritePackets(audioFile_, false,
00093            allocatedBlockSizeInBytes, NULL,
00094            currentPacket,&ioNumPackets,
00095            audioData);
00096  
00097  if((status != noErr) || (ioNumPackets == 0))
00098  {
00099   printf("DiskOut: error: writing file\n");
00100   AudioFileClose(audioFile_);
00101   audioFile_ = 0;
00102  }
00103  else
00104  {
00105   currentPacket += ioNumPackets;
00106  } 
00107 }

00109 DiskOutUGenInternalWav16::DiskOutUGenInternalWav16(AudioFileID audioFile, 
00110                AudioStreamBasicDescription const& format, 
00111                UGen const& input) throw()
00112 : DiskOutUGenInternal(audioFile, format, input)
00113 {
00114 }
00115 
00116 void DiskOutUGenInternalWav16::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00117 {
00118  static const float factor = 0x7FFF;
00119  
00120  const int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00121  checkBufferSize(blockSize);
00122  
00123  if(audioFile_)
00124  {  
00125   for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00126   {
00127    const float *inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00128    float *outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00129    memcpy(outputSamples, inputSamples, blockSize * sizeof(float));
00130    
00131    SInt16* audioFileSamples = (SInt16*)audioData + channel;
00132    int numSamplesToProcess = blockSize;
00133    
00134    while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00135    {
00136     *audioFileSamples = (SInt16)(*inputSamples * factor);
00137     inputSamples++;
00138     audioFileSamples += numChannels;
00139    }
00140   }  
00141   
00142   writeBuffer(blockSize);
00143  }
00144 }

00191 void DiskOutUGenInternalWav24::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()

00203    float *outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();

00228 void DiskOutUGenInternalAiff24::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00229 {
00230  static const float factor = 0x7FFFFFFF; // try 32 bit... and take the 3 MSBs
00231  
00232  const int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00233  checkBufferSize(blockSize);
00234  
00235  if(audioFile_)
00236  {  
00237   for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00238   {
00239    const float *inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00240    float *outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00241    memcpy(outputSamples, inputSamples, blockSize * sizeof(float));
00242    
00243    char* audioFileSamples = ((char*)audioData) + (channel*3);
00244    int numSamplesToProcess = blockSize;
00245    
00246    while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00247    {
00248     int sample = (int)(*inputSamples * factor);
00249     char *samplePtr = (char*)&sample;
00250     audioFileSamples[0] = samplePtr[3];
00251     audioFileSamples[1] = samplePtr[2];
00252     audioFileSamples[2] = samplePtr[1];
00253     inputSamples++;
00254     audioFileSamples += (numChannels * 3);
00255    }
00256   }  
00257   
00258   writeBuffer(blockSize);
00259  }
00260 }

00338 DiskOut::DiskOut(Text const& audioFilePath, UGen const& input, bool overwriteExisitingFile, int bitDepth) throw()
00339 { 
00340  enum AudioFileType { WAV, AIFF };
00341  AudioFileType type;
00342  
00343  TextArray split = audioFilePath.split(".");
00344  int splitLength = split.length();
00345  
00346  Text pathChecked; 
00347  if(splitLength <= 1)
00348  {
00349   pathChecked = audioFilePath << ".wav";
00350   type = WAV;
00351  }
00352  else
00353  {
00354   pathChecked = audioFilePath;
00355   if(split.last().equalsIgnoreCase("aif") || 
00356      split.last().equalsIgnoreCase("aiff"))
00357   {
00358    type = AIFF;
00359   }
00360   else
00361   {
00362    type = WAV;
00363   }
00364  }
00365  
00366  bool success = false;
00367  
00368  if(type == AIFF)
00369  {
00370   if(bitDepth == 24)
00371    success = initWithAudioFileAiff24(pathChecked.getArray(), input, overwriteExisitingFile);
00372   else if(bitDepth == 32)
00373    success = initWithAudioFileAiff32(pathChecked.getArray(), input, overwriteExisitingFile);
00374   else
00375   {
00376    if(bitDepth != 16)
00377     printf("DiskOut: warning: bit depth of %d not supported, using 16\n", bitDepth);
00378    success = initWithAudioFileAiff16(pathChecked.getArray(), input, overwriteExisitingFile);
00379   }
00380  }
00381  else if(type == WAV)
00382  {
00383   if(bitDepth == 24)
00384    success = initWithAudioFileWav24(pathChecked.getArray(), input, overwriteExisitingFile);
00385   else if(bitDepth == 32)
00386    success = initWithAudioFileWav32(pathChecked.getArray(), input, overwriteExisitingFile);
00387   else
00388   {
00389    if(bitDepth != 16)
00390     printf("DiskOut: warning: bit depth of %d not supported, using 16\n", bitDepth);
00391    success = initWithAudioFileWav16(pathChecked.getArray(), input, overwriteExisitingFile);
00392   }
00393  }
00394  
00395  
00396  
00397  // unnecessary?
00398 // if(!success)
00399 // {
00400 //  initInternal(1);
00401 //  internalUGens[0] = getNullInternal();  
00402 // }
00403 }

00405 bool DiskOut::initWithAudioFileWav16(const char *audioFilePath, 
00406           UGen const& input, 
00407           bool overwriteExisitingFile) throw()
00408 {
00409  Text path; // this needs to be here so it doesn't get garbage collected too early
00410  
00411  if(audioFilePath[0] != '/')
00412  { 
00413   path = NSUtilities::pathInDirectory(NSUtilities::Documents, audioFilePath);
00414   audioFilePath = path.getArray();
00415  }
00416  
00417  CFURLRef fileURL = CFURLCreateFromFileSystemRepresentation(NULL, 
00418                   (UInt8*)audioFilePath, 
00419                   strlen(audioFilePath), 
00420                   false);
00421  
00422  AudioStreamBasicDescription format;
00423  
00424  const int numChannels = input.getNumChannels();
00425  
00426  format.mChannelsPerFrame = numChannels;
00427  format.mSampleRate   = UGen::getSampleRate();
00428  format.mFormatID   = kAudioFormatLinearPCM;
00429  format.mFormatFlags   = kAudioFormatFlagIsSignedInteger | kAudioFormatFlagIsPacked;
00430  format.mBitsPerChannel  = 16;
00431  format.mBytesPerFrame  = format.mChannelsPerFrame * format.mBitsPerChannel / 8;
00432  format.mFramesPerPacket  = 1;
00433  format.mBytesPerPacket  = format.mBytesPerFrame * format.mFramesPerPacket;
00434  
00435  AudioFileID audioFile;
00436  OSStatus status = AudioFileCreateWithURL(fileURL,
00437             kAudioFileWAVEType,
00438             &format,
00439             overwriteExisitingFile ? kAudioFileFlags_EraseFile : 0,
00440             &audioFile);
00441  
00442  if(status != noErr) return false;
00443  
00444  initInternal(numChannels);
00445  generateFromProxyOwner(new DiskOutUGenInternalWav16(audioFile, format, input));
00446  
00447  return true; 
00448 }
